title: The algebraic and geometric classification of $3$-Poisson algebras
summary: $3$-Poisson (ternary Nambu--Poisson) algebras are the algebras of observables of Nambu mechanics, the generalization of Hamiltonian mechanics in which the time evolution $\dot f=\{f,H_1,H_2\}$ is governed by two Hamiltonians and preserves the phase volume; their $3$-Lie part also gives the gauge algebra of the Bagger--Lambert--Gustavsson model of multiple M2-branes.
